settings.privacy_note_body: The photo, text, or YouTube transcript you provide — whether fetched automatically by the app or uploaded manually — may be sent to our backend and AI providers for Vietnamese translation and IPA generation. The app does not keep the original photo by default and does not send full content to analytics. Avoid uploading highly sensitive content.

settings.support_prompt: Send feedback or report a bug by email. The app doesn't include lesson content in the email — please describe the issue in words.

create.headline: Paste a video link to create a lesson
create.subhead: We fetch English subtitles, translate them to Vietnamese, and add IPA for each sentence.
